ANA.head: The Ducks have changed
lede: This season they’re leaving more of the shooting to the forwards and shooting less.
They still hound the puck in the other team's end.
ANA.history_text: The Ducks have made the playoffs in three of the last ten seasons; last spring they went out in the second round.
